verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules engine that runs actions automatically when events occur. Webhooks only deliver events to the developer's own endpoint, where the developer must build any action. Card Configurations are spending restrictions, a related control rather than event-triggered actions. Auto-deletion is a single preset date-based behavior per card, not a general rule-on-event capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
